senses.zh: 动作片；动作电影；电影类型是动作片

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 卡通片， 动画片；连环漫画

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。

ex.en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
ex.zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

ex.en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their culture.
ex.zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.zh: 著名的；极好的，非常令人满意的

ex.en: This village is famous for its delicious apple pies.
ex.zh: 这个村庄以美味的苹果派闻名。

ex.en: Famous landmarks attract international visitors, but tourism revenue should also support the communities surrounding them.
ex.zh: 著名地标吸引着国际游客，但旅游收入也应惠及周边社区。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。famous for接出名的原因，famous as接身份。

senses.zh: 出现；显得；似乎；出庭；登场

ex.en: Stars began to appear as the sky grew darker.
ex.zh: 天空渐渐变暗，星星开始出现。

ex.en: Online courses appear to offer greater flexibility, although some learners still prefer traditional classroom interaction.
ex.zh: 网络课程似乎提供了更大的灵活性，但一些学习者仍更喜欢传统课堂互动。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。

ex.en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
ex.zh: 商店关门后，街道变得安静起来。

ex.en: Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.
ex.zh: 如果城市希望居民减少开车，公共交通就必须变得更可靠、更实惠。

col: become increasingly important｜变得日益重要
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。变化形式：become—became—become；后接名词或形容词。

ex.en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
ex.zh: 他们富有的叔叔在海边拥有一栋大房子。

ex.en: Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.
ex.zh: 富裕国家可以通过投资贫困地区的清洁能源项目来支持全球发展。

col: rich in nutrients｜富含营养成分
rich cultural heritage｜丰富的文化遗产
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。“富含……”用 rich in，不用 rich of。

ex.en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
ex.zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。

ex.en: Successful recycling programmes depend on convenient collection facilities and clear guidance for households and businesses.
ex.zh: 成功的回收计划依赖便利的收集设施，以及面向家庭和企业的明确指引。

col: successful in doing something｜成功做成某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

senses.zh: 可以；或许（may的过去式）；应该

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 主要部分，要点；体力；总管道
主要的，最重要的；全力的

ex.en: The main entrance is beside the little coffee shop.
ex.zh: 正门就在那家小咖啡馆旁边。

ex.en: One main reason for urban migration is the wider range of employment opportunities available in cities.
ex.zh: 人们迁往城市的一个主要原因是城市提供的就业机会更多。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。形容词通常放在名词前；主要地用mainly。

ex.en: The heavy rain was the reason we stayed home.
ex.zh: 大雨是我们待在家里的原因。

ex.en: One reason for rising urban rents is that housing supply has failed to keep pace with population growth.
ex.zh: 城市租金上涨的一个原因是住房供应未能跟上人口增长。

col: reason with someone｜和某人讲道理
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。常用reason for加名词，或reason why加从句。

senses.zh: 共同的；普通的；一般的；通常的

ex.en: Heavy rain is common here during the summer.
ex.zh: 这里夏天经常下大雨。

ex.en: Governments should address the common challenges that prevent rural communities from accessing affordable healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应解决阻碍农村社区获得可负担医疗服务的共同难题。

col: have something in common｜有共同之处
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。common指常见或共有；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

senses.zh: 在…上覆以薄膜；把…拍成电影
摄制电影；生薄膜；变得朦胧

ex.en: We watched a funny film after dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Documentary films can raise public awareness of environmental problems by showing their effects on local communities.
ex.zh: 纪录片可以通过展示环境问题对当地社区的影响，提高公众的环保意识。

col: a thin film of oil｜一层薄薄的油膜
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。表示电影时，film偏英式，movie偏美式。

ex.en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。

ex.en: Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.
ex.zh: 电影可以向观众介绍陌生文化，不过有时也会强化刻板印象，而非打破它们。

col: go to the movies｜去看电影
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。movie偏美式，英式常用film；the movies可指电影院。

senses.zh: 不幸的；倒霉的；不吉利的

ex.en: We were unlucky to miss the bus by seconds.
ex.zh: 我们真倒霉，只差几秒就错过了公交车。

ex.en: Students who are unlucky enough to fall ill during examinations should be offered alternative assessment arrangements.
ex.zh: 不幸在考试期间生病的学生应获得其他考核安排。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。unlucky强调运气差，不等于unhappy（不开心）。

senses.zh: 浪费；使沉溺于；使迷路；遗失；错过

ex.en: I always lose my keys inside this enormous bag.
ex.zh: 我总是在这个大包里找不到钥匙。

ex.en: Small businesses may lose customers when major retailers offer similar products at significantly lower prices.
ex.zh: 大型零售商以低得多的价格提供类似产品时，小企业可能会流失顾客。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。
📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 准备好；现成的；迅速的；情愿的；快要…的

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
ex.zh: 晚饭好了，请把你的盘子拿来。

ex.en: Schools must ensure that students are ready to meet the demands of a rapidly changing workplace.
ex.zh: 学校必须确保学生做好准备，以应对快速变化的职场需求。

col: ready and willing｜乐意且准备好
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。ready for后接名词；ready to后接动词原形。

senses.zh: 准备好；准备做某事；预备

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 性格，品质；特性；角色； 字符

ex.en: Her cheerful character makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
ex.zh: 她开朗的性格让阴雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.zh: 笨蛋；愚蠢的行为；出身低微者

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
ex.zh: 这道简单的菜只需十分钟就能做好。

ex.en: Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.
ex.zh: 学校应提供简单易懂的说明，让所有学生都能独立完成课堂任务。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。simple可指容易或朴素，不一定表示简陋。

senses.zh: 乔装；装扮；为…打扮；盛装打扮
穿上盛装；装饰；精心打扮

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

ex.en: My cousin joined the army after leaving school.
ex.zh: 我的表亲毕业后参军了。

ex.en: During major floods, the army can provide essential transport and supplies when civilian services are overwhelmed.
ex.zh: 发生严重洪灾时，如果民用服务不堪重负，军队可以提供必要的运输服务和物资。

col: serve in the army｜在陆军服役
an army of volunteers｜大批志愿者
tip: 📘 8A Unit 5。army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

senses.zh: 好好干；干得好；干得很好

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 莎拉（女子名）；萨拉（《圣经》中的人物）

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 迪士尼；华特迪士尼；迪斯尼

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5
📘 8A Unit 5

senses.zh: 米老鼠；分掷炸弹的装置；多余或无关重要的东西
米奇；米奇老鼠；有声电影米奇老鼠

tip: 📘 8A Unit 5
📘 8A Unit 5
📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 计算机程序员；计算机程序设计员；计算机程设计员
电脑程序员；电脑程序设计人；电脑程序设计师

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

ex.en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天气变冷时，我通常会煮蔬菜汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
ex.zh: 教孩子做简单饭菜，可以培养更健康的饮食习惯，让他们日后更加独立。

col: cook from scratch｜从原材料开始做饭
a good cook｜做饭好吃的人
cook over low heat｜用小火烹调
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。cook可指厨师；cooker在英式英语中指炉灶。

senses.zh: 修理；篡改，伪造；为…治病；授以博士学位

ex.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
ex.zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。

ex.en: Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应培养更多医生，确保农村社区能够稳定获得医疗服务。

col: a doctor of philosophy｜哲学博士
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。

ex.en: An engineer checked the bridge before it opened.
ex.zh: 一位工程师在桥梁通车前进行了检查。

ex.en: Engineers can reduce urban energy consumption by designing buildings that require less heating and cooling.
ex.zh: 工程师可以通过设计供暖和制冷需求更低的建筑来减少城市能源消耗。

col: engineer a solution｜精心设计解决方案
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。

senses.zh: 小提琴演奏者，小提琴家

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 驾驶员；驱动程序；起子；传动器

ex.en: The bus driver waited while I found my ticket.
ex.zh: 公交车司机等着我找到车票。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can be a major driver of economic growth in expanding cities.
ex.zh: 在不断扩张的城市，公共交通投资可以成为经济增长的重要驱动力。

col: a key driver of growth｜增长的关键驱动因素
install a driver｜安装驱动程序
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。a driver of change指推动变化的因素。

ex.en: The pilot landed the plane smoothly despite strong winds.
ex.zh: 尽管风很大，飞行员还是平稳地让飞机着陆了。

ex.en: The council launched a pilot scheme to assess whether free bus travel would reduce traffic congestion.
ex.zh: 地方议会推出了一项试点计划，以评估免费乘坐公交车能否缓解交通拥堵。

col: pilot a programme｜试行一个项目
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。

ex.en: The pianist smiled before playing her favourite song.
ex.zh: 那位钢琴演奏者微微一笑，开始弹奏她最喜爱的歌曲。

ex.en: A professional pianist usually needs years of disciplined practice as well as opportunities to perform publicly.
ex.zh: 职业钢琴家通常既需要多年严格的练习，也需要公开演出的机会。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。pianist指演奏者；乐器钢琴是piano。

ex.en: The scientist examined a drop of water under the microscope.
ex.zh: 这位科学家用显微镜观察了一滴水。

ex.en: Scientists are developing more efficient batteries to support the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研发效率更高的电池，以支持从化石燃料向可再生能源的转型。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。scientist指人，science指科学，scientific是形容词。

senses.zh: 就象…一样地不容怀疑。；把握
对……有把握；对……很肯定；相信

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 尽力做到；深信；务必；务请

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

ex.en: My cousin is studying nursing at a local college.
ex.zh: 我表姐正在当地一所学院学习护理。

ex.en: Making college education more affordable could improve social mobility and provide employers with a more skilled workforce.
ex.zh: 降低高等教育费用可以促进社会流动，并为雇主提供技能更强的劳动力。

col: go to college｜上大学或学院
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。美式常泛指大学；英式多指学院或继续教育院校。

ex.en: Her grandparents saved money to pay for her education.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母攒钱供她读书。

ex.en: Access to quality education can improve employment prospects and reduce inequality across different social groups.
ex.zh: 获得优质教育的机会能够改善就业前景，并缩小不同社会群体之间的不平等。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

ex.en: The pharmacist explained how often to take the medicine.
ex.zh: 药剂师解释了这种药应该多久服用一次。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have increased life expectancy, but access to effective treatment remains unequal across regions.
ex.zh: 医学进步延长了预期寿命，但各地区获得有效治疗的机会仍不平等。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。服药用take medicine；表示医学时不可数。

senses.zh: 大学；综合性大学；大学校舍

ex.en: My sister studies engineering at a university near home.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在离家不远的一所大学读工程学。

ex.en: Governments should improve access to university so that talented students are not excluded by financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应扩大接受大学教育的机会，避免有才华的学生因经济障碍被拒之门外。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring London by bus.
ex.zh: 我们在一个下雨的下午乘公交车游览了伦敦。

ex.en: London attracts international students because its universities offer diverse courses and access to extensive cultural resources.
ex.zh: 伦敦吸引着国际学生，因为当地大学提供多样的课程和丰富的文化资源。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。城市名首字母大写；通常不加the。

senses.zh: 文章；物品；条款； 冠词
订约将…收为学徒或见习生；使…受协议条款的约束

ex.en: I read an interesting article about growing tomatoes indoors.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于室内种植番茄的有趣文章。

ex.en: The article examines how access to green spaces influences mental health in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 这篇文章探讨了在密集人口城市中，绿地的可及性如何影响心理健康。

col: an article of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

senses.zh: 发送，寄；派遣；使进入；发射

ex.en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
ex.zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。

ex.en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。

col: send someone to do something｜派某人去做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。
📘 8A Unit 6

ex.en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。

ex.en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
ex.zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.zh: 外国的；外交的；异质的；不相关的

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。

ex.en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
ex.zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。

senses.zh: 能； 有能力的；能干的

ex.en: I am finally able to swim across the pool.
ex.zh: 我终于能够游到泳池的另一端了。

ex.en: With reliable internet access, rural students are able to attend courses previously available only in cities.
ex.zh: 有了可靠的互联网接入，农村学生就能参加以前只有城市才提供的课程。

col: an able leader｜能干的领导者
an able student｜有才干的学生
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。表示能够做某事用be able to do，不用able doing。

senses.zh: 会；有能力做某事；强调有能力

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 允诺，许诺；给人以…的指望或希望

ex.en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
ex.zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。

ex.en: Although renewable technologies show considerable promise, further investment is needed to make them widely affordable.
ex.zh: 虽然可再生能源技术展现出巨大潜力，但仍需进一步投资，使其价格能被大众接受。

col: promise to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。用promise to do，不用promise doing。

ex.en: We missed the beginning of the film yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天错过了电影的开头。

ex.en: The beginning of formal education marks an important stage in a child's social development.
ex.zh: 正规教育的开始标志着儿童社会性发展的一个重要阶段。

col: at the beginning of｜在……开始时
from beginning to end｜从头到尾
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。at the beginning of后接名词；in the beginning表示起初。

senses.zh: 的起初；的开始；在……的开始

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

ex.en: My cooking has improved since I started practising daily.
ex.zh: 自从开始每天练习，我的厨艺进步了。

ex.en: Investing in teacher training can improve educational outcomes, especially in schools serving disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训可以改善教育成果，尤其是在服务弱势社区的学校中。

col: improve access to｜改善获取……的机会
improve living standards｜提高生活水平
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。

senses.zh: 记下来；贬低；减低账面价值；把…拨作公积金

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 物理的；身体的；物质的；根据自然规律的，符合自然法则的

ex.en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
ex.zh: 每个周末做园艺活都让我得到充分的身体锻炼。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.
ex.zh: 规律的体育活动能够改善公众健康，并减轻国家医疗体系的财政压力。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。
📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 与…有关；和……有关系；与…有关系

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6
📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 拿起；举起；拾起；给搭(火车等)

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex.zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

ex.en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
ex.zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

col: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好
a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好
pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

senses.zh: 油漆；绘画；装饰；涂色于；描绘；（用语言，文字等）描写；擦脂粉等
油漆；颜料，涂料；绘画作品；胭脂等化妆品；色彩，装饰

ex.en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
ex.zh: 你的双手沾满了蓝色颜料。

ex.en: Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.
ex.zh: 学校应让孩子经常绘画，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和自我表达。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。

senses.zh: 每周的；周刊的；一周一次的

ex.en: Our weekly shopping trip usually ends at the bakery.
ex.zh: 我们每周的购物之行通常以去面包店收尾。

ex.en: Weekly exercise classes at community centres can help older residents stay active and build social connections.
ex.zh: 社区中心每周开设的健身课可以帮助老年居民保持活力并建立社交联系。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。既可作形容词也可作副词：a weekly meeting；meet weekly。
📘 8A Unit 6

ex.en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
ex.zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。

ex.en: Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.
ex.zh: 研究人员越来越质疑，在现代办公环境中，延长工作时间是否真的能提高生产效率。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。动词question可直接接人，表示询问或盘问。

ex.en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
ex.zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？

ex.en: Volunteering can give people a sense of meaning while strengthening connections within their local communities.
ex.zh: 志愿服务既能让人感到生活有意义，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。

col: the meaning of a word｜词义
give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

ex.en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们边吃晚饭边商量度假计划吧。

ex.en: Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.
ex.zh: 学生应先讨论不同的解决办法，再决定如何减少校园垃圾。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

ex.en: I finally have my own room in our new flat.
ex.zh: 在我们的新公寓里，我终于有了自己的房间。

ex.en: People who own their homes may feel more financially secure, although maintenance costs can be substantial.
ex.zh: 拥有住房的人可能在经济上更有安全感，不过房屋维护费用也可能相当高。

col: my own room｜我自己的房间
of your own｜属于你自己的
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。own表“自己的”前通常有物主词，如my own。

senses.zh: 人事消息栏；人称代名词

ex.en: Please keep your personal belongings close while boarding the train.
ex.zh: 上火车时，请将个人物品放在身边。

ex.en: Online services should protect personal information and explain clearly how they collect and use customer data.
ex.zh: 在线服务应保护个人信息，并清楚说明如何收集和使用客户数据。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。personal指个人的；personnel指全体员工，注意拼写。

ex.en: She has a warm relationship with her younger sister.
ex.zh: 她和妹妹的关系很亲密。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在调查城市社区中绿地的可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip: 📘 8A Unit 6。与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

senses.zh: 海明威(①姓氏 ②Ernest, 1899-1961, 美国小说家, 曾获1954年诺贝尔文学奖)

tip: 📘 8A Unit 6
📘 8A Unit 6

senses.zh: 贴糊墙纸；发交通违章传票

ex.en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
ex.zh: 她用鲜黄色的纸把小礼物包了起来。

ex.en: The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.
ex.zh: 这所大学鼓励学生以电子形式提交作业，以减少各院系的纸张消耗。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。纸不可数，用a piece of paper；论文、报纸可数。

ex.en: Air pollution makes the distant hills difficult to see.
ex.zh: 空气污染让远处的山丘难以看清。

ex.en: Reducing pollution requires governments to regulate industrial emissions while encouraging cleaner transport and more sustainable production methods.
ex.zh: 减少污染需要政府监管工业排放，同时鼓励更清洁的交通方式和更可持续的生产方式。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。pollution不可数；具体污染物用pollutant。

ex.en: Your prediction was right: it rained all afternoon.
ex.zh: 你预测对了：整个下午都在下雨。

ex.en: Accurate predictions of future energy demand are essential for planning reliable and sustainable electricity supplies.
ex.zh: 准确预测未来能源需求，对于规划可靠且可持续的电力供应至关重要。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。作出预测用make a prediction，不用do。

ex.en: We talked about our future while walking home.
ex.zh: 我们走路回家时聊了聊我们的未来。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to protect the environment for future generations worldwide.
ex.zh: 各国政府应投资可再生能源，为世界各地的子孙后代保护环境。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。in the future指将来；英式in future常指从今以后。

ex.en: Please don't pollute the stream by throwing rubbish into it.
ex.zh: 请不要往小溪里扔垃圾，污染溪水。

ex.en: Factories that pollute local rivers should face stricter penalties to protect ecosystems and public health.
ex.zh: 污染当地河流的工厂应受到更严厉的处罚，以保护生态系统和公众健康。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。及物动词，直接接被污染的对象，不加介词。

ex.en: We cycle to school to help protect the environment.
ex.zh: 我们骑车上学，为保护环境出一份力。

ex.en: A supportive learning environment can improve students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively.
ex.zh: 支持性的学习环境能够增强学生的信心，鼓励他们更加积极地参与。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。泛指自然环境常用the environment。

ex.en: We watched a bright planet through the telescope tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我们用望远镜观察了一颗明亮的行星。

ex.en: Scientists study distant planets to understand whether conditions suitable for life exist beyond Earth.
ex.zh: 科学家研究遥远的行星，以了解地球以外是否存在适合生命的条件。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。planet是行星，star是恒星；the planet常指地球。

senses.zh: 地球；地表，陆地；土地，土壤；尘事，俗事；兽穴
把（电线） 接地；盖（土）；追赶入洞穴

ex.en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
ex.zh: 孩子们用小铲子挖开湿润的泥土。

ex.en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
ex.zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。指行星时常写Earth；on earth中不加the。

senses.zh: 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

senses.zh: 部分；角色；零件；一些；片段

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7

senses.zh: 起作用；扮演角色；扮演一个角色

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7

ex.en: I enjoy the peace of this garden before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早餐前这座花园里的宁静。

ex.en: Lasting peace depends on cooperation between communities and fair access to essential resources.
ex.zh: 持久和平有赖于各群体之间的合作以及公平获取基本资源的机会。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。

ex.en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
ex.zh: 孩子们看着小船在海上航行。

ex.en: Plastic waste entering the sea threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human food supplies.
ex.zh: 进入海洋的塑料垃圾威胁海洋野生生物，并可能最终影响人类的食物供应。

col: a sea of faces｜人头攒动
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。at sea指在海上；by the sea指在海边。

ex.en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。

ex.en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

senses.zh: 把…投向空中；把…挂得过高
踢或击高空球；把桨叶翘得过高；飞涨

ex.en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
ex.zh: 我们步行回家时，天空变成了橙色。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民无法清楚地看到夜空中的星星。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。通常用the sky；skies常用于描述天气或某地天空。

senses.zh: 宇航员，航天员；太空旅行者

ex.en: The astronaut floated gently through the small space station.
ex.zh: 那名宇航员轻轻地飘过小型空间站。

ex.en: Astronauts conduct experiments in space that help scientists understand how the human body responds to weightlessness.
ex.zh: 宇航员在太空中开展实验，帮助科学家了解人体对失重的反应。

col: a team of astronauts｜一队宇航员
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。astronaut是宇航员；astronomer是天文学家。

ex.en: Our apartment has a small balcony overlooking the park.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓有一个面向公园的小阳台。

ex.en: Building affordable apartments near railway stations can reduce commuting costs for young workers.
ex.zh: 在火车站附近建设价格可负担的公寓，可以降低年轻上班族的通勤成本。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。

senses.zh: 飞驰，飞快地移动；迅速增加

ex.en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
ex.zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。

ex.en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
ex.zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
ex.zh: 我的自行车旁边有足够的地方放你的车。

ex.en: Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.
ex.zh: 在人口密集的社区增加绿地，可以改善居民身心健康并鼓励户外锻炼。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。

senses.zh: 太空站；航天站；宇宙空间站
国际空间站；空间电台；宇宙站

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7

ex.en: This robot can recognise a familiar human voice.
ex.zh: 这个机器人能识别熟悉的人声。

ex.en: Human activity has significantly altered natural habitats, making wildlife conservation an urgent priority for governments.
ex.zh: 人类活动已显著改变自然栖息地，使野生动物保护成为各国政府迫切需要优先处理的事项。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。human是“人类的”；humane是“人道的”。

ex.en: The servant carried fresh towels into the guest bedroom.
ex.zh: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。

ex.en: In wealthy households of the past, servants often worked long hours with little legal protection.
ex.zh: 过去，富裕家庭的佣人往往长时间工作，却很少受到法律保护。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。

ex.en: That broken step is dangerous, so please avoid it.
ex.zh: 那级破损的台阶很危险，请避开它。

ex.en: Poorly maintained roads can create dangerous conditions for cyclists, especially during heavy rain or after dark.
ex.zh: 维护不善的道路会给骑行者带来危险，尤其是在大雨中或天黑后。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。dangerous是形容词；修饰动作要用dangerously。

ex.en: I have already packed my bag for tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我已经收拾好明天要用的包了。

ex.en: Many cities have already introduced cycling schemes to reduce traffic congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 许多城市已经推出骑行计划，以缓解交通拥堵并改善公众健康。

col: already in place｜已经就位；已落实
tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。常置于助动词后、实义动词前；表示已经或比预期早。

ex.en: My aunt works at a factory that makes bicycles.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一家生产自行车的工厂工作。

ex.en: Governments should require factory owners to reduce harmful emissions without compromising the safety and livelihoods of their workers.
ex.zh: 政府应要求工厂主减少有害排放，同时不损害工人的安全和生计。

tip: 📘 8A Unit 7。复数为factories；指制造产品的场所。
